Example 3.29(a)
contents.reason: This is the explicit cusp parametrization t mapsto (t^2,t^3). The present A-page harvest records the morphism theorem that explains it, while the pointwise witness itself belongs on the companion examples page.

contents.name: Example 3.30
contents.reason: Milne's Frobenius bijection is a positive-characteristic purely inseparable warning. This pair stays on the classical affine-morphism, local-ring, and rational-map dictionary and does not add a separate characteristic-p pathology item here.

contents.name: Definition 5.7
contents.reason: The abstract separation axiom for general algebraic prevarieties is deliberately postponed. This page specializes only the dense-open uniqueness consequence needed for affine targets and does not scaffold separatedness as its own notion yet.

contents.name: Example 5.9
contents.reason: The doubled-origin line is the standard nonseparated warning, but this page stays inside affine varieties and records only the source-side reason not to assert a maximal domain for arbitrary nonseparated targets.

sources.title: Donu Arapura, Notes on Basic Algebraic Geometry
sources.locator: Contents page (PDF p. 2); Chapter 1 §1.5 `Affine Varieties` and §1.6 `Hilbert’s Nullstellensatz` through Corollary 1.6.4 (PDF pp. 10-12); and Chapter 3 §§3.1-3.3 `Rational functions`, `Quasi-projective varieties`, and `Graphs` through Proposition 3.3.1 and Exercise 3.3.2 (PDF pp. 26-28).

contents.name: 1.5 Affine Varieties
contents.reason: This is the prerequisite AV-1 definition of a classical affine variety. It is reused here as prior page context, not re-scaffolded as a new AV-2 item.

contents.name: Lemma 1.5.4
contents.reason: The domain criterion for coordinate rings is already authored on the prerequisite AV-1 page and is only reused here to justify the function-field construction.

contents.name: Example 3.1.1
contents.reason: This is the projective-space computation k(P^n) = k(A^n). The current page uses only the affine function-field side; projective function fields belong with the next projective page.

contents.name: Lemma 3.1.2
contents.reason: The finite affine-cover statement is about quasi-projective varieties in general. This batch adds only the affine-open definition and the affine function-field comparison actually needed before AV-3.

contents.name: Proposition 3.3.1
contents.reason: The design itself authorizes moving the graph row until products are available. This proposition is therefore recorded now but scaffolded only once AV-4 supplies the product-variety infrastructure.

contents.name: Exercise 3.3.2
contents.reason: The closed-graph-without-regularity converse is not part of the current dependency route once the graph lemma is deferred to AV-4. The current examples page already has an affine indeterminacy witness and the cusp bijection witness without adding a separate graph-converse branch.
